text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having run the Sapporo Kinen, Fine Motion 
and Air Groove praise each other's 
efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer receives a phone call from 
Fine Motion's older sister, who expresses 
gratitude for drawing out her younger 
sister's true feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fans who heard about her return swarmed 
the airport. She tells them, "Please watch 
my last run."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next race might be her last. The 
Trainer narrowed the target down to four 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While it was possible to enter every race, 
Fine Motion was forced to decide which one 
she wanted to approach in peak 
condition...
